status: Configuration written before fitting these new models; hypotheses informed by previously inspected data, so exploratory rather than independent confirmation
input: 58 numerical/range compounds, 26 constitutional middle groups, existing frozen folds and two saved source-label scenarios
primary: Fixed positional fragment-descriptor Ridge(alpha=10) versus the existing frozen nearest3 predictions on leave-middle-family-out MAE
secondary: Fixed Ridge(alpha=10) with middle-descriptor interactions with exact Gly-tail and hydroxy-tail indicators
Same interaction features, squared distance-to-reported-interval loss plus alpha=10 coefficient penalty
Leave-one-pair-out prediction of Gly-extension effect in all 11 complete matched core/Gly pairs, constant training mean versus fixed middle-descriptor Ridge(alpha=10)
features: Six neutral-graph monomer descriptors at middle position; summed descriptors of exact parsed tail monomers; tail length, hydroxy attachment, exact single-Gly tail and explicit D/allo counts. Interaction model adds six middle descriptors times each of Gly-tail and hydroxy-tail indicators. No use of source-assay target in features.
validation: Reuse old folds, fit scaling inside training folds, preserve source versions separately, evaluate midpoint MAE and distance-to-reported-interval MAE. Ten-thousand whole-family bootstrap repetitions, seed 2701026, conditional on fits. No neural training, threshold tuning, hyperparameter sweep or candidate promotion.
promotion: A positive exploration requires primary MAE-gain lower bound above zero against existing nearest3 under both source scenarios; it still needs a new independent source before confirmation. Secondary-only gain is hypothesis generation.
sensory: Retrieve primary human-sensory methods where possible; maintain matrix, dose, NaCl, response endpoint and independent source status. Do not infer a sodium-reduction percentage from receptor potency or a fixed-NaCl enhancement score.
censoring: Numerical ranges remain reported bounds, not CIs. Nine qualitative non-activators and one explicit bound excluded from this regression comparison; never invent an assay ceiling for them.
